old_strategy: Only 10 numeric variable aliases; mathematical comparator required.
Rejected any with/without/and/or/e.g. regardless of whether the changed factor was atomic.
Required exact literal units and a single numeric mention, rejecting equivalent units and threshold paraphrases.
Rejected qualitative threshold statements rather than synchronizing them with the same measurement.
Original-pair matching required nearly identical complete vignettes; alternate source vignettes vary unrelated wording and numbers.
Old generation gate counted numeric approved candidates alone; separately valid original pairs could never satisfy the generation gate.
Single-letter A-Z option cap blocked valid full guidelines with more than 26 distinct actions.
new_strategy: Source-text reviewed atomic availability/feasibility predicates and numeric thresholds are registered explicitly.
One contiguous condition clause changes; derived threshold/feasibility wording updates with that same factor.
Independent original tree route and terminal action checks, distinct nodes, all original ancillary facts retained.
Numeric ancestor thresholds are evaluated before/after even when the same numerical clause is edited.
Clinical action incompatibility is reviewed per current decision episode; shared ancillary care is not itself treated as equality.
All inference labels stay single-token and the full original action set is preserved.
unreliable_examples_retained: Age 10 months with at least one year of prior treatment, gid45 path2: impossible temporal history; excluded.
ECOG4 explicitly said not greater than2 in old candidate: invalid original state, excluded.
HbA1c duplicate unit representation needs verified conversion/rounding and action-compatibility review: not admitted.
Platelet transfusion versus avoiding plasma transfusion concerns distinct products: compatible, not admitted.
Ambiguous multiple attributes, prior executed target actions, and donor consideration compatible with bridging care: not admitted.
sampling_limitations: Reviewed catalogue is a curated program-verifiable subset, not exhaustive corpus-wide mining.
37 pairs are explicit feasibility/access conditions; only 3 are physiological numeric thresholds.
No observed model predictions were used in source selection.
Same original source fact summaries are not clinical expert certification.
